company.name: Alpha-9 Oncology
company.shortDescription: Alpha-9 Oncology is a biopharma company that focuses on radiotherapeutics for the treatment of solid and hematologic malignancies.

productsAndServices.description: Alpha9 Theranostics develops radiotherapeutic molecules for treating solid and hematologic malignancies, utilizing a toolbox of technologies for peptide-based radiopharmaceuticals.
productsAndServices.name: Engineered molecules

productsAndServices.description: Radiopharmaceuticals by Alpha9 Theranostics are designed for selective radiation delivery to cancer cells, comprising binders, linkers, chelators, and radioisotopes for optimal selectivity and stability.
productsAndServices.name: Radiopharmaceuticals

productsAndServices.description: The company selects targets for radiopharmaceutical development based on differentiated expression and radioactive payload delivery to tumor cells while minimizing exposure to healthy organs.
productsAndServices.name: Target selection

productsAndServices.description: Alpha9 conducts imaging and dosimetry studies to demonstrate proof-of-concept for targets and provide feedback on molecule design, using imaging radioisotopes for tumor visualization.
productsAndServices.name: Imaging and dosimetry studies

productsAndServices.description: Therapy studies by Alpha9 are guided by human data from imaging and dosimetry studies, using high-energy isotopes for patient treatment in trials similar to Phase I/II.
productsAndServices.name: Therapy studies

productsAndServices.description: Alpha-9's research facilities in Vancouver support chemistry, biology, translational research, and radiochemistry R&D teams, accelerating the pipeline of radiopharmaceuticals.
productsAndServices.name: Alpha-9 facilities

aiResearchSummary.text: Alpha-9 Oncology is developing stable radiopharmaceutical compositions and uses thereof, focusing on stabilized radiopharmaceutical formulations comprising radiolabeled conjugates of formula RC L TM for improved dosage forms. They are also creating compositions targeting bradykinin receptor B one for medical imaging and treatment and gastrin releasing peptide receptor targeted compounds and uses thereof for imaging and treating receptor expressing diseases, highlighting work in stabilized radioconjugates and receptor targeted radiotherapeutics.
